workingTitleZh: 天地神谕（暂定，名称待 Heather 确定）
status: DESIGN — anchor-first. Full art ingredients authored for the 6 anchor cards only; the other 34 are catalogued (name + reflective meaning) and get detailed ingredients after the anchors pass QC.
theme: An original oracle rooted in classical Chinese mythology and folklore (public-domain sources such as 山海经, 淮南子, folk legend) — celestial deities, the four guardians and mythic creatures, and the forces of the Dao. Reflective and grounded, not fortune-telling spectacle.
copyrightStance: Public-domain mythology only. Fully original art. Do NOT reproduce any existing game/anime/film character design of these figures (e.g. no 原神/王者荣耀-style renditions). Ride the cultural source, invent the depiction.
_generatorNote: This manifest uses the general pipeline schema (title as {en,zh}; per-card fields mustInclude/twist/paletteHint/compositionHint/avoid). The existing scripts/generate-deck-art.mjs reads a flat string title plus mustKeep/stillpointTwist — it needs a small generalization (accept {en,zh} title and the general field names) before it can consume this manifest. Generation is deferred until anchors are designed in full and Heather is ready.

brandBrief.rendering: Painterly editorial illustration with an East-Asian ink-wash sensibility: confident brush-feel, generous negative space (留白), restrained detail, believable anatomy, soft atmosphere. Modern and premium, not historical reproduction.
brandBrief.border: Elegant light border with a subtle cloud/line (云纹) motif, identical across every card. No text, titles, or numerals inside the art.
brandBrief.palette: Traditional Chinese mineral-pigment palette: ink black, rice-paper cream, cinnabar/朱砂 red, azurite/石青 blue, malachite/石绿 green, aged gold. Muted and harmonious, never neon or garish.
avoid: any text, titles, Roman or Chinese numerals, watermarks, logos, accidental lettering
copying any existing game/anime/film character design of these mythic figures
Western fantasy art conventions that erase the East Asian rooting

globalPromptBullets: Create a single portrait-format oracle card illustration for an original Chinese-mythology oracle deck.
Root the figure in its classical source but invent a fully original depiction; do not copy any existing artwork, game, anime, or film design.
Use an ink-wash-meets-painterly style with generous negative space; readable at thumbnail, graceful at full size.
Keep the mood contemplative and reverent, not gothic spectacle or cute mascot.
Make every card feel like part of one unified, premium 40-card deck.
No text, no titles, no numerals, no watermark, no logo.
anchorRationale: These six stress-test the style across the deck's full range: a repeating guardian-creature (azure-dragon, sets the 四象 consistency bar), a quiet emotional figure in a dark palette (change), a bright fiery expressive case (vermilion-bird), a minimal abstract symbol (taiji), a narrative action scene (houyi), and a somber heavy figure (meng-po). If the style holds here, it is safe to expand to the full 40.

meaning.en: The rising force of the east — spring, beginnings, momentum that gathers like weather.
meaning.zh: 东方升发之力——春、开端，如天气般聚拢的势能。

mustInclude: a sinuous Chinese dragon coiling through cloud and rain
cards.twist: Power as quiet inevitability rather than aggression — the dragon as the turning of a season, not a monster.
cards.paletteHint: Azurite blue, malachite green, rain silver, a thread of gold scale.
cards.compositionHint: Diagonal upward sweep, lots of misted negative space, clear silhouette at thumbnail.

meaning.en: Distance and longing — the cost of ascent, beauty held far from what it loves.
meaning.zh: 距离与思念——飞升的代价，美被高悬在所爱之外。

mustInclude: a solitary woman figure on the moon
vast moon disc and cold night sky
a jade hare or osmanthus tree as quiet companion symbol
cards.twist: Not a romantic moon goddess but a study in chosen solitude — serene, a little sorrowful, fully composed.
cards.paletteHint: Moonlit ivory, deep indigo night, pale silver, faint osmanthus gold.
cards.compositionHint: Strong vertical stillness, figure small against a large moon, generous emptiness.

meaning.en: The blazing south — full expression, summer, the courage to be wholly seen.
meaning.zh: 炽烈的南方——全然的表达、夏，敢于被完全看见的勇气。

mustInclude: a phoenix-like vermilion bird with spreading flame-feathers
cards.twist: Brightness as openness, not destruction — warmth that reveals rather than burns.
cards.paletteHint: Cinnabar red, warm gold, ember orange against pale cream.
cards.compositionHint: Radial spread, strong central figure, bright but controlled contrast.

meaning.en: Balance — the turning of opposites, neither side winning, both needed.
meaning.zh: 衡——阴阳相生相转，无一方独胜，二者皆需。

mustInclude: an abstract evocation of the taiji turning (light and dark in motion)
cards.twist: Render it as living motion and brush energy, not the flat logo — balance felt as a slow turning.
cards.paletteHint: Ink black and rice-paper cream, a single restrained accent of gold.
cards.compositionHint: Centered circular composition, maximal negative space, pure and quiet.
avoid: literal symmetry that reads as a stamp

meaning.en: The necessary shot — decisive sacrifice, doing the hard thing that restores balance.
meaning.zh: 必要的一箭——果决的牺牲，做那件恢复平衡的难事。

mustInclude: an archer drawing a great bow toward the sky
suns/golden crows being shot from the heavens
cards.twist: Heroism as solemn duty, not triumph — the weight of the choice visible in the figure.
cards.paletteHint: Scorched gold, deep sky blue, earth ochre, ember red.
cards.compositionHint: Dynamic tension along the bow's line, sky-heavy upper frame, clear narrative read.

meaning.en: Forgetting — release before the next beginning, laying a burden down at the threshold.
meaning.zh: 忘——在下一段开始前放手，在桥头将重担卸下。

mustInclude: an old woman offering a bowl of broth
a dim threshold or bridge of passage
cards.twist: Tender rather than eerie — forgetting as mercy, the kindness of being allowed to let go.
cards.paletteHint: Dusk grey, faded jade, dim lantern gold, soft shadow.
cards.compositionHint: Quiet frontal offering, low warm light, heavy stillness with breathing room.

meaning.en: Beginnings carved from chaos — the first separation that makes a world possible.
meaning.zh: 从混沌中开辟——使世界得以成形的第一次分离。

meaning.en: Mending what is broken — care that patches the sky and remakes the whole.
meaning.zh: 修补破损——补天的关怀，重新成全整体。

meaning.en: Reading the patterns — order found by patiently watching the world.
meaning.zh: 观象——在耐心观察世界中找到秩序。

meaning.en: Keeper of thresholds — guardian of what must be earned, not taken.
meaning.zh: 守界者——守护那些须靠修得、而非夺取之物。

meaning.en: Order and hierarchy — the rule you answer to, for better or worse.
meaning.zh: 秩序与位阶——你须回应的那套规则，无论好坏。

meaning.en: Burning vitality — life force so strong it risks scorching.
meaning.zh: 炽盛的生命力——强到可能灼伤的活力。

meaning.en: The hidden and the cyclical — quiet knowing that waxes and wanes.
meaning.zh: 隐与循环——盈亏之间安静的明了。

meaning.en: Orientation — finding true north when you are lost.
meaning.zh: 指向——迷失时找到真正的方向。

meaning.en: Love stretched across separation — devotion that distance cannot cut.
meaning.zh: 横跨分离的爱——距离斩不断的牵念。

meaning.en: Faithful waiting — keeping the promise through the long apart.
meaning.zh: 忠诚的守候——在漫长的分离中守住承诺。

meaning.en: Sudden reckoning — the jolt of truth that cannot be argued with.
meaning.zh: 骤然的清算——无可辩驳的真相之击。

meaning.en: The cutting west — autumn, courage, the clean severance that frees.
meaning.zh: 肃杀的西方——秋、勇气，使人解脱的果断切断。

meaning.en: The still north — winter, endurance, depth that outlasts.
meaning.zh: 沉静的北方——冬、耐力，比一切更长久的深沉。

meaning.en: Renewal through ending — what rises only because something burned.
meaning.zh: 由终结而新生——因有所焚毁才得以升起。

meaning.en: Gentleness that harms nothing — strength chosen to be kind.
meaning.zh: 不伤万物的温柔——选择以仁示人的力量。

meaning.en: Momentum — power that moves the weather of your life.
meaning.zh: 势——能改变你人生天气的力量。

meaning.en: Transformation and allure — the mask, and what it both hides and reveals.
meaning.zh: 化与魅——面具，以及它所掩藏与显露之物。

meaning.en: Steadiness — the weight that holds when everything else moves.
meaning.zh: 镇定——万物皆动时仍稳住的重量。

meaning.en: Flow — the wisdom of surrendering to the current.
meaning.zh: 流——顺应水势的智慧。

meaning.en: Belonging — the small local protector of where you stand.
meaning.zh: 归属——守护你立足之地的小小神明。

meaning.en: Slow growth — patience rooted deeper than any season.
meaning.zh: 缓长——比任何季节都扎得更深的耐心。

meaning.en: Stubborn devotion — carrying stones to fill an impossible sea.
meaning.zh: 执——衔石填海般固执的献身。

meaning.en: Vast transformation — outgrowing the scale you were born to.
meaning.zh: 化境——超越你与生俱来的尺度。

meaning.en: Protection — facing squarely what frightens you.
meaning.zh: 驱邪——正面直视令你恐惧之物。

meaning.en: The threshold — what cannot be delayed, only met.
meaning.zh: 临界——无法拖延、只能面对之事。

meaning.en: Unconventional paths — many different ways across the same sea.
meaning.zh: 异途——渡过同一片海的种种不同方式。

meaning.en: The pursuit that consumes — chasing the sun until it costs everything.
meaning.zh: 逐——追日直至耗尽自身。

meaning.en: Perseverance — moving the mountain across generations.
meaning.zh: 恒——以世代之力移山。

meaning.en: Fated connection — the unseen threads that bind people together.
meaning.zh: 缘分——将人系在一起的无形之线。

meaning.en: Receptivity — rest, the dark that holds and restores.
meaning.zh: 受——休养，承托并修复的暗。

meaning.en: Action — brightness, the move outward into the world.
meaning.zh: 动——明亮，向世界迈出的行动。

meaning.en: Vital breath — the living energy moving through everything.
meaning.zh: 息——流贯万物的生命之气。

meaning.en: The way — flow without forcing, the path that makes itself.
meaning.zh: 道——顺势而不强求，自成之路。

meaning.en: The formless before form — pure potential, not yet decided.
meaning.zh: 未分之形——纯粹的可能，尚未定型。
